Subject: Next steps from today — 30-min product intro (3 proposed windows)

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the candid discussion about your latency SLAs and data residency needs. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goals: reduce inference cost for customer-facing features, meet 99th percentile latency target < 120ms, and keep PII in a private VPC.
- Current constraints: mixed traffic patterns (spiky mornings), internal compliance questionnaire still in progress.

Next step: 30-minute product intro where we walk through Redwood Inference in a short demo + clarify the Dedicated vs Private deployment tradeoffs for your compliance team. Please pick one of these windows (all times PT):

1) Tue May 25 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed May 26 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu May 27 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Recommended attendees from your side: technical reviewer (platform/infra), product owner. From our side: myself (sales) + Ben Carter (platform architect).

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot and the attendee list. I attached a 1-page discovery summary from today's call for reference.

Thanks,
Grace

Hi all — thanks again for confirming the demo. A couple items ahead of Wednesday that will make the 30 minutes more effective:

1) Attached: gateway-mutual-action-plan.docx — I sketched a draft MAP with typical milestones (POC, dedicated capacity sizing, SOC2 evidence handoff).
2) Attachment: gateway-discovery-notes.pdf — added a few technical details from our discovery (expected qps, peak concurrency patterns, current model sizes).

If you have time before the demo, could you share answers to these 2 quick questions?
- Expected average request size (tokens) and typical request/response sizes so I can show realistic perf numbers.
- Any constraints on outbound connections from your VPC (eg. allowlist requirements, proxy)?

I'll keep the demo focused on runtime performance and secure deployment patterns; plan to show a short 5-minute live inference followed by architecture slides.
